review_notes: I read the whole file, which has one theorem. Two blocks look repeated. First, `hbase` and `hspan` each prove `Set.range (fun j ↦ F (x j)) = F '' Set.range x` by the same `ext`/`rintro` argument. Mathlib already has this as `Set.range_comp'`, at Mathlib/Data/Set/Image.lean:644. So this is a short routine step that existing API covers, not nontrivial repeated reasoning that needs a new shared lemma. Second, `hfun` is stated and proved twice in the final two bullets. That is a one-line `funext` and could be hoisted to a single `have`, but the rubric says moving duplicated branches into a helper is not enough. Everything else (the `hcotangent`, `hbase`, `hspan` chain and the exactness step) occurs once. I found no repeated mathematical machinery that is worth extracting into a lemma. I checked `Set.range_comp'` in Mathlib. I did not look at other files in the library for similar uses.
